india.one_line: India pushes to become the global AI application capital as enterprises move pilots to full production.

themes.title: India targets AI application leadership
themes.text: Union Electronics and Information Technology Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that India is focused on becoming the artificial intelligence application capital of the world.

stories.headline: India focused on becoming AI application capital of the world: Ashwini Vaishnaw

themes.title: Enterprises move AI to full production
themes.text: Oracle India reported that local businesses have shifted from AI pilot tests to full-scale enterprise production over the past year and a half.

stories.headline: Oracle India says firms are moving from AI pilots to full-scale production

themes.title: New enterprise AI models and partnerships
themes.text: Sarvam AI released the Prism open-weight decision model, while Coforge joined the SpaceX partner network to deploy Grok tools for clients.

stories.headline: Sarvam launches Prism open-weight decision model built on Sarvam 105B
Coforge joins SpaceX partner network to deploy Grok for clients
